question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. **

FAKE
solution: The correct answer is '**Genuine**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Fake**' is '**Genuine**'. • **Fake**: not genuine; imitation or counterfeit. (नकली) • *Example: She got on the plane with a **fake **passport.* • **Genuine**: real; true. (वास्‍तविक; असली) • *Example: He thought that he had bought a **genuine **Rolex watch but it was a cheap fake.* **Correct Answer:__** *Genuine.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Bogus**: pretending to be real or genuine. (असली होने का ढोंग करते हुए; बनावटी, खोटा, जाली) • **Artificial**: not genuine or natural but made by people. (मानव द्वारा बनाया गया, न कि प्राकृतिक; कृत्रिम, नक़ली; अप्राकृतिक) • **False**: not true; not correct. (असत्‍य, ग़लत) 3e:Tc45, The correct answer is '**appeared**'.
